liveReproduction.reason: The worker probe creates a new ephemeral execution thread and sends a real turn. The existing desktop target must not be resumed. Any new live probe needs an explicit local target/lifecycle designation.

requiredReviewChecks: Resolve the full candidate/base and inspect their exact diff; do not review the mutable branch head.
Verify the listed source blobs from their pinned commits; read the role contract first.
Review generic adapter ACK matching separately from the worker exact thread/turn/status/text checker.
Check pre-send reservation, persistence callback, duplicate refusal and uncertain-delivery reconciliation; distinguish process-local and durable guarantees.
Check request deadlines, initialization notification, notification buffering and shutdown/error behavior.
Confirm unregistered, busy and unknown targets refuse dispatch; verify no production runtime paths changed.
Run focused tests and typecheck independently; report executed versus merely inspected checks.
Do not infer complete role/base/lock scheduling checks from the feasibility tests.
Separate accepted transport response, completed turn and exact ACK; preserve desktop BLOCKED.
State drift/compatibility limits against observed main without inventing current-main acceptance.
